messages:
mira: FYI Elysian Health invoice INV-15009 failed with card_declined and SCA required. Seen 2026-09-14 08:45 UTC.
jon: paste the webhook lines?
mira: 
```
event: evt_Ely123
pi: pi_Ely12345
charges.data[0].failure_code: card_declined
failure_message: \"Card declined: 3DS required\"
three_d_secure: required
outcome.risk_level: 0.76
card_brand: Visa
last4: 5555
```
jon: customer replied — treasury rotated virtual card and their provider blocked 3DS flows. They asked for wire or ACH micro-deposits.
billing-bot: Automatic retry schedule: attempt1 now, attempt2 +6h, attempt3 +48h.
mira: They explicitly asked to stop retries and send a wire option. Also asked for invoice to include PO# EH-332 and their tax id.
payments-ops: Pause retries on profile elysianhealth_com. Create manual invoice INV-15010 for $9,400 (monthly + usage) net 3 and include PO EH-332. Use GL 4520.
jon: Approve one-time waiver of late fee? They had a virtual card provider blocking 3DS. Approver: jon.
stripe-agent: Opening Stripe case stripe_case_20260914-EH to flag virtual-card/3DS issues and request guidance.
mira: I'll call treasury and request payer legal name + remittance email. Also will send ACH verification form link and secure bank link for wire.
payments-ops: When you have bank ref, record via internal API. Example (ops-only):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/payments/manual" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-15010","amount_cents":940000,"method":"wire","note":"Elysian Health wire 2026-09-14 PO EH-332"}'
```
mira: Sent secure link to bank details and ACH form. Call scheduled 10:30 PT. Paused retries so they don't get duplicate emails.
billing-bot: INV-15010 created and emailed to treasurer@elysianhealth.com. Automatic retries paused for INV-15009.
jon: Also ask them if Ramp (virtual card provider) can whitelist our MCC — could prevent future blocks.
mira: Call done. Treasury confirmed wire sent and provided bank ref (redacted). Uploaded remittance screenshot to vault. Redacted ref: EH-WIRE-900.
payments-ops: Received bank ref EH-WIRE-900. Recording manual payment now and marking INV-15010 awaiting settlement. Will mark paid after funds clear.
stripe-agent: stripe_case_20260914-EH opened. Following up with Stripe about virtual-card 3DS handling.
mira: Thanks everyone. Closing thread after reconciliation. :lock: :white_check_mark:
